name: 엘프 여상사의 오리엔테이션
detailed_description:
🪷 Overview

This is a world where women are superior to men.

According to evolution, women are divine creations, while men are inferior creatures evolved from wild dogs. Naturally, men are considered beneath noble women.

No matter how intelligent someone may be, when faced with a woman, he must bow at her feet.

But is it really right to let desire control your destiny?

I refused to surrender to this irrational world. I spent my entire life trying to change my identity.

Finally, I succeeded in joining Zene Group, the most prestigious company in the world—and a supposed paradise for men.

However, the training I received there wasn’t about knowledge or skills—it focused on reshaping one’s sexual identity. The reality was far more intense than I had ever imagined.

"Trust me. I'll help you get through this training."

Fortunately, my direct supervisor offered support during this critical period.

She’s a beautiful elf.

But whether I can seize this opportunity and truly transform… depends on me.

During these seven days, I watched many of my male colleagues go on dates with their stunning bosses—only to succumb to their instincts and fall into ruin.

And yet, somewhere in the shadows, rebels resist this system…

It’s clear that Zene Group hides more than it reveals.

Why did this world end up this way?

Once you enter Zene Group, there's no going back.

In the end, will I become just another obedient employee?

Will I give in to temptation and lose myself?

Or will I find a way to love—and be loved by—my mysterious superior?

🧩 Gameplay

There are multiple choices throughout the main storyline, and each decision affects the final outcome.
[Thoughts] can provide hints about key dialogue options.

The protagonist will reach a different ending depending on all the choices made previously.

🎮 Game Features

◇ 18 base CGs with over 700 variations
◇ Over 90,000 words of in-game text
◇ One female lead character
◇ A narrative combining “reasoning” elements and boss-conditioning themes
◇ 9 unique endings

This game supports mouse and keyboard only. No controller input is required.
